units.name: assign-crystal-substrate
units.value: (((INTERFACE.metadata.get('build') or [{}])[-1].get('configuration') or {}).get('stack_components') or [{}])[0].get('stack_components', [{}])[0].get('crystal') if INTERFACE.metadata else None

units.name: assert-crystal-substrate
units.errorMessage: Could not extract the substrate crystal from the interface build metadata.

units.name: assign-bulk-substrate-material-ids
units.value: [m['_id'] for m in DATA] if DATA else []

units.name: assert-bulk-substrate
units.errorMessage: No material matched the substrate crystal hash. Upload the bulk material first.

units.name: assign-crystal-film
units.value: (((INTERFACE.metadata.get('build') or [{}])[-1].get('configuration') or {}).get('stack_components') or [{}, {}])[1].get('stack_components', [{}])[0].get('crystal') if INTERFACE.metadata else None

units.name: assert-crystal-film
units.errorMessage: Could not extract the film crystal from the interface build metadata.

units.name: assign-bulk-film-material-ids
units.value: [m['_id'] for m in DATA] if DATA else []

units.name: assert-bulk-film
units.errorMessage: No material matched the film crystal hash. Upload the bulk material first.

units.name: assign-n-substrate
units.value: len([e for e in INTERFACE.basis.elements if e.value in [x.value for x in BULK_SUBSTRATE.basis.elements]]) / BULK_SUBSTRATE_NATOMS

units.name: assign-n-film
units.value: len([e for e in INTERFACE.basis.elements if e.value in [x.value for x in BULK_FILM.basis.elements] and e.value not in [x.value for x in BULK_SUBSTRATE.basis.elements]]) / BULK_FILM_NATOMS

units.name: assign-vacuum-size
units.value: (((INTERFACE.metadata.get('build') or [{}])[-1].get('configuration') or {}).get('stack_components') or [{}, {}, {}])[2].get('size', 0) if INTERFACE.metadata else 0

units.name: assert-te-bulk-substrate
units.errorMessage: Bulk total energy not found for substrate. Run a Total Energy workflow on the substrate bulk first.

units.name: assert-te-bulk-film
units.errorMessage: Bulk total energy not found for film. Run a Total Energy workflow on the film bulk first.

template.name: pw_scf.in
